items.t: Coquitlam East condos and townhomes for sale

blocks.text: Coquitlam East homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Coquitlam East, September 2026. Detached houses: 28 listed at month end and 4 sold in September, a sales ratio of 14% (a balanced market). Condos and townhomes: 9 listed at month end and 1 sold in September, a sales ratio of 11%.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 18 sold over 4 months against an average of 30.0 listed, about 6.7 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was July with 5 sold. Condos and townhomes: 5 sold over 4 months against an average of 10.0 listed, about 8.0 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 2 sold.

faq.q: Which school district and schools serve Coquitlam East?
faq.a: School District 43 (Coquitlam). For the sample address 1195 Lansdowne Drive, the SD43 locator result is Eagle Ridge Elementary, Scott Creek Middle and Gleneagle Secondary; Gleneagle Secondary itself is at 1195 Lansdowne Drive; catchments are address-based, so check the exact address in the locator.

faq.q: What sold in Coquitlam East in September 2026?
faq.a: Detached: 4 solds from 28 listings (14% sales ratio); condos & townhomes: 1 sold from 9 listings (11%). At the Coquitlam community level the detached median sale price was $1,455,000 and the condos & townhomes median was $625,000 (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats GVR September 2026 report).
Coquitlam Central Station (Millennium Line, Evergreen Extension) is the main station for east Coquitlam, and it also has West Coast Express service.

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Coquitlam East?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 28 houses listed with 4 sold in the month and 9 condos and townhomes listed with 1 sold in the month in Coquitlam East. Those are month-end counts and move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Coquitlam East a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 14%, a balanced market; condos and townhomes had a sales ratio of 11% on too few listings to read as a market type. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.
